name: Mirror Goggles (Lesser)
text:
These goggles feature highly reflective lenses. While wearing the goggles, you gain a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks and to saving throws against visual effects.

---
Activate R (manipulate)

Trigger A creature within 60 feet targets you with a visual effect

Effect You turn your head to reflect aspects of the triggering effect back at its creator. The creature must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save save as it becomes disoriented by this reflection. On a failure, the creature is Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). The creature is temporarily immune for 1 hour.
